description: Collect the result of record_screen or convert_video_link by job id. Waits up to 50 seconds; call it again while it says it is still working. Also accepts a tellscreen.com/v/ link to fetch the change list of an existing Tellscreen video.

job.description: The job id returned by record_screen or convert_video_link.

video_url.description: Or: a tellscreen.com/v/… link (keep any ?agent= in it).

name: get_change_list
title: Collect a change list
